description: A verifier key in the ledger's tagged form (midnight:verifier-key[v6]), given to the contract operation the adapter tests deploy (test/ledger/adapter-fixtures.ts): a deploy needs one for every operation, and with contract proof checks off (LG-15) the ledger never verifies a proof against it. The file is byte-identical to zswap/static/spend.verifier of midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger, Apache-2.0, at ledger-8.1.0, 9.1.0.0-rc.3 and 9.1.0.0-rc.5 alike.
